name: Victor Lazlo
subtitle: Sideline inbound play
goal: Get an easy basket straight off a sideline inbound.
options: First: 1 going deep. Next: 4 coming to the sideline off 5's screen. Backup: 2 in the backcourt.

steps.note: 3 inbounds at half court. 1 and 2 face each other along the sideline. 5 is in the middle of the court and 4 is on the far side. On "break", 2 comes to 1 and sets a screen.
1 explodes off the screen straight down the court to the basket. 1 is the first target for an easy basket.
The big closer to the inbounder screens away: 5 screens for 4.
4 comes off the screen toward the sideline to receive the ball. 2 stays in the backcourt as the backup.
3 reads it: 1 deep first, then 4 near the sideline, then 2 in the backcourt.
